QUOTE: "Always Allow/Deny" choices are persisted to the project YAML by `PermissionPersister`, and `add_permission` adds them at runtime.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says choices are persisted to "the project YAML" by `PermissionPersister`, but it never names config.local.yaml or says persistence appends to that file separately from `add_permission`.
